enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to shoulders. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Extend legs. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, toasting bread and brewing tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Take bread from refrigerator. Put bread in toaster. Boil water in kettle. Brew tea in mug. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put notebook and pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the arts organization office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Take elevator. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: coordinating exhibition schedules and answering partner emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Type responses. Make phone calls. Talk on phone. Open calendar. Schedule meetings. Print documents. Review documents. Write notes. Attend meeting. Discuss schedules. Coordinate with colleagues. Send emails. Update spreadsheet. File paperwork.
Walk to cafe. Order food. Pay for food. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator: meeting with artists, reviewing grant paperwork and venue logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to meeting room. Greet artists. Shake hands. Sit at table. Discuss exhibition details. Take notes. Review grant paperwork. Sign documents. Make phone calls. Check venue logistics. Send emails. Coordinate with venue staff. Attend another meeting. Talk with colleagues. Update project plan. Print materials. Organize files. Respond to messages. Prepare for next day.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Serve food. Set table. Call Member 1. Sit with Member 1. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Finish eating. Pick up plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen counters with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Scrub dishes with sponge. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counters with cloth. Put away leftover food. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Talk with Member 1 while cleaning.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Watch TV. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work on the computer, drawing on the monitor with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open drawing software. Open project file. Pick up stylus. Draw on monitor. Adjust layers. Change brush size. Select color. Fill area. Save file. Open reference image. Continue drawing. Erase mistakes. Zoom in and out. Save file again. Close software. Turn off computer and desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water. Shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Wash face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open to page. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Sleep.
